answer: A sybil tax raises a toll ridge before every new identity: each agent pays a 40 POA entry tax, burned. One honest agent pays once; a forger running 100 fakes pays 4,000 POA up front. A jetty from the honest shore: proven agents pay half, flagged accounts double. A hollow identity — no real trades, no attested work — pays full tax each epoch, so 100 fakes bleed 4,000 POA per epoch for 2 POA each. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards.
